narrative: DeployBench's 51-task deployment suite shows four state-of-the-art models scoring just 7.8 to 51 percent, with the dominant failure being agent-terminated self-stops that declared success against a weaker target than required. That isolates completion verification - not raw capability - as the binding constraint, and because the defect lives in the harness rather than the model, it is fixable exactly at the framework layer the forecast names.
remaining_gap: Frameworks have not yet shipped goal-grounded completion verification as a default; today supplies the motivating measurement only.
